text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, while catching my breath at 
the training track――

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you over there. Got a teeny-tiny 
second?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, one of my underclassmen came to 
me with a su~per serious question about 
wanting to get faster!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If it were just based on intuition, it'd 
be easy-peasy, but she really wants to 
study the proper theory, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Teaching someone when you're not even 
their trainer feels kind of irresponsible, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still... she worked up the courage to 
confide in me, so I really want to help 
sort it out properly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, I got to wondering, "What kind of 
advice would a pro like you give?" y'know~
choice_data_list: Teach how to use the knees

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's true, how you use the power in your 
knees is super important~. It works 
wonders for start dashes too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, got it. I've got the picture 
now. Hunky-dory! Thanks a bunch♪

All throughout that day, I could see her 
across the grounds, passionately teaching 
her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see, I see~ Basic stamina, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
True enough, you have to build basic 
stamina first. That plateau might be 
coming from a lack of it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds like I can give some good 
advice! Hunky-dory! Thanks a bunch♪

All throughout that day, I could see her 
across the grounds, training hard 
alongside her juniors.
